# Advanced Methods and Artificial Intelligence

Student presentations in this chapter concern advanced computational methods,
deep learning, natural-language processing, and artificial intelligence.

| Presentation | Presenter | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| [LLM Agents](../topic/parkins-llm-agents/) | Jack Parkins | Shows how an LLM agent answers a data question by calling tools in a loop, using a small stock-return example with a click-through trace and cached model turns so it renders without an API key. Covers bad tool arguments, runaway loops, and why agent evaluation needs confidence intervals. |
